body:
Completion audit of STORY-1843 on origin/main c51da86593 (worktree fin-story-1843, claimed). PR1 (597ea98e77) and the scoped-down PR2 (b6aa5e8701: dry-run + manifest refusal + liveness fixes) are the only merged slices.

DONE on main (tests exist; I can anchor them):
- Folded findings BUG-2204 delivery half, TASK-2133, TASK-2134, TASK-2177, TASK-2178, TASK-2179, TASK-2219: mailbox_resolver.rs plus tests at :426-:1059, mailbox.rs:1874/:1911, agent_registry.rs:3637-:3696.
- C1 zero-reader refusal and C3 dry-run (mailbox_migration.rs:420/:493).
- AC acfeb946, refusal half only (unknown/dead handle refused, no phantom inbox).

GAP (each is a new subsystem, and together they are far over 300 lines, so I have NOT built them):
1. AC aca8ca0d: one stable handle per session at start. touch_session_start_agent uses only AIDA_AGENT_NAME or the lease name. Missing: vendor-role-NN generation, the common-root allocation lock and reservation, the UUID binding (sketch PR2), and name bounds/reservation.
2. AC aceb5213: no handle segment in statusline_contract/statusline_cmd for claude/codex/agy.
3. AC ac97b025: `aida agent ls` prints "No active agents found" from the sandboxed CLI while live agents exist; no handle/role/spec/liveness columns for all vendors.
4. AC acfeb946, delivery half: send-by-handle to a per-UUID inbox with private ack (sketch PR2 schema).
5. AC ac0eef56: antigravity-hooks.json ships only the PreInvocation expiry notice. Missing: agy SessionStart registration, a per-turn mail notice, and a black-box Claude-to-agy test (sketch PR3).
6. Signoff C2 PR4: relay lifetime (stable label, gap queue, end/crash bounce outbox, reuse handover) plus an aida-relay version gate. It lives in ~/ai/aida-relay, outside this repo. Only PR4 completes the story.
7. C3 write-mode migration: advisor ruling 1c/1d says the operator runs it, a later PR.

Plan (needs a ruling): split into Refs slices, each with STRICT review per signoff.
(a) PR2b: handle allocation + statusline + agent ls, about 600 lines.
(b) PR3: hook templates for claude/codex/agy + agy black-box test, about 400 lines.
(c) PR4: relay in AIDA plus aida-relay, completing.
Alternative: re-scope the story's acceptance down to what has shipped and file (a)-(c) as new specs.
Holding: no code written, no PR opened. Awaiting your ruling.
subject: GAP: STORY-1843 handles, statusline, raw-client hooks, agy delivery, relay (PR2b-PR4)
